get_fused_adam_class: get the best available FusedAdam optimizer class from apex by trying deprecated then newer interface
create_FusedAdamV1_optimizer: create a FusedAdamV1 optimizer with custom learning rate betas and weight decay for GPU training
run_FusedAdamV1_step: run a single optimization step with optional gradient scaling and max gradient norm clipping
create_FusedAdamV2_optimizer: create a FusedAdamV2 optimizer that extends Apex FusedAdam with multi tensor apply support
run_FusedAdamV2_step: run a single optimization step on FP16 and FP32 parameter groups using multi tensor applier
